title: North Star Bangle
descriptionHtml:
Stars and stones, in turn. A slim flat bangle, about 6mm wide and mirror polished, its outer face alternating an engraved eight-point north star with a tiny stone at its heart and a round clear stone set flush in a bezel. In bright silver or warm gold tone.

STYLING TIP: Stack the silver and the gold together on one wrist.

Details

  • Style: Slim rigid oval bangle
  • Band: Approximately 6mm wide, mirror polished
  • Pattern: Engraved eight point north stars, each with a tiny stone at its centre, alternating with round clear cubic zirconia in flush bezels
  • Plating: Rhodium plated silver tone or 18k gold tone plated (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
